scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node tools/check-web-build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:ui: playwright test --grep-invert "three-parameter sweep runs all eight bounded cases in the browser engine|imported device model parameters can be stepped through the browser ngspice engine|AC source validation focuses its inspector field before simulation|first use: run the RC starter|voltage source SINE waveform is editable and runs in the browser ngspice engine|LTspice voltage EXP waveform is editable and simulates in the browser engine|LTspice current-source SINE waveform edits and simulates in the browser engine|first use: reduced-motion preference pauses result animation but keeps manual playback|import, place, and simulate a user-supplied IC|capacitor initial voltage editor starts the transient at the requested voltage|RLC example opens and solves|PWL waveform example opens with editable points and solves|current-source example demonstrates|controlled-source example opens and solves|transistor switch example demonstrates|MOSFET switch example demonstrates|PMOS switch example demonstrates|N-JFET example demonstrates|import a user NJF model|current-controlled sources example shows|stop terminates an active ngspice run"
scripts.test:e2e:engine: playwright test --grep "three-parameter sweep runs all eight bounded cases in the browser engine|imported device model parameters can be stepped through the browser ngspice engine|AC source validation focuses its inspector field before simulation|first use: run the RC starter|voltage source SINE waveform is editable and runs in the browser ngspice engine|LTspice voltage EXP waveform is editable and simulates in the browser engine|LTspice current-source SINE waveform edits and simulates in the browser engine|first use: reduced-motion preference pauses result animation but keeps manual playback|import, place, and simulate a user-supplied IC|capacitor initial voltage editor starts the transient at the requested voltage|RLC example opens and solves|PWL waveform example opens with editable points and solves|current-source example demonstrates|controlled-source example opens and solves|transistor switch example demonstrates|MOSFET switch example demonstrates|PMOS switch example demonstrates|N-JFET example demonstrates|import a user NJF model|current-controlled sources example shows|stop terminates an active ngspice run"
scripts.build:release: npm run check:ngspice-release && npm run typecheck && vite build --mode release
